BTS Photo — HEIC / HEIF decoder (loaded on demand as separate files)

libheif.js, libheif.wasm
  from the npm package libheif-js 1.23.5 (libheif-wasm build) by Kiril Vatev
  https://github.com/catdad-experiments/libheif-js — LGPL-3.0 (LICENSE-libheif-js.txt)
  libheif — https://github.com/strukturag/libheif — LGPL-3.0 (LICENSE-libheif.txt),
  including the libde265 HEVC decoder (LGPL-3.0).
  Unmodified. Shipped as separate, replaceable files that the app loads at run time.
